LEDGER M1: the most a road can lose

LEDGER M1: the morale a regiment with full stores climbs toward

the most days ArmySystem.march_days_between walks a route before it gives the figure up (a guard, never reached on a pack: ten years)

march waypoints (spec 2026-10-07-march-waypoints §1): a route through waypoints is sampled into a whole-metre point every this many metres of chord per leg (MarchRoute) — the line drawn and walked; a 3 km chord on a 50 km bend strays 20 m
march waypoints (spec §1, ruling 3): the most waypoints one ARMY_MARCH may name; Add waypoint and a bend stop there

march slope (owner 2026-10-10, spec 2026-10-10-march-slope-detour): the march grid's cell in pack px (4 px = 200 m of the 3D world, 10 Terrain3D vertices): tools/map3d/bake_march_grid.py bakes one cell per this many px into the pack's geography/march_grid.png and MarchPath reads it back by the same key
march slope (bake_march_grid.py): the heights are box-blurred over this radius in 3D-world metres before the slope is taken, so 20 m vertex noise and a house terrace do not read as a cliff
march slope (bake_march_grid.py): the slope is the rise across this run of 3D-world metres (a central difference), the scale a column climbs at; a cell keeps the steepest it holds

march slope (bake_march_grid.py): a cell with fewer of its vertices above the waterline than this per mille is water, impassable to a land column (rivers stay fordable: a 200 m cell is never mostly river)

march slope (MarchPath.nearest_open): a march that starts or ends on a closed cell (a scarp, a shore) is routed from the nearest open cell within this many cells; none nearer and it walks the straight line

march slope (owner 2026-10-10: 山坡斜度超过一定限制，军队必须走最近的绕道): a land column never crosses a march-grid cell steeper than this, rise per run in per mille as the 3D map draws it (1000 = 45 degrees: the terrace scarps block, the ridged mountains and every gentle hill do not); MarchPath routes round it
LEDGER M1: points morale moves toward its mark a month
regiments: share of the wounded who return to the ranks each month, per mille, at least 1 while any are wounded
regiments: training gained each month (placeholder: none)
regiments: how far a regiment's hidden attack/defence against an arm floats round its base each month, per mille
regiments: the training factor of power at training 0
regiments: the training factor gained per point of training (100 -> 1500)
regiments: the morale factor of power at morale 0
regiments: the morale factor gained per point of morale (100 -> 1000)
regiments: power over the mean of the player's regiments of the same kind at/above which a regiment reads Strong
regiments: power over that mean at/below which a regiment reads Weak

regiments' march (owner 2026-09-19): the weight of the arm itself in a regiment's readiness — the base pace is its slowest arm's (data/army_speed.csv); this share of it is always kept, however hungry or beaten the regiment. readiness = (w_arm*1000 + w_supply*S + w_morale*M + w_training*T) / sum of weights, per mille
regiments' march: the weight of supplies (S = the supply score: full at army_supply_low_days days in hand, falling linearly to 0, per mille)
regiments' march: the weight of morale (M = morale x 10)
regiments' march: the weight of training (T = training x 10)

height in war (owner 2026-09-19, spec 2026-09-19-map3d-heights-design §2): per mille a side gains for every 100 m it stands above the other in a fight, and the lower side loses; ArmySystem.height_factor
height in war: the most a height difference moves a side's power either way, per mille (+-30%, reached at 750 m)
